sourceProject.description: A Vite + React 18 + Tailwind v3 + framer-motion landing-page CLONE of a real, live commercial marketing site (an AI operations platform for ISPs), built as a deliberate PLACEHOLDER clone under a fictional 'Acme' brand.
sourceProject.location: sibling folder of design-repo/ in the delivery (not included in this package; nothing here depends on it)

measured: template home and its seven sections, footer, demo dialog, cookie banner, all tokens
derived: template legal-prose, sections legal.header and legal.body
excluded: 'From the field' testimonial carousel (deliberate scope exclusion)

licensing.note: This design-repo describes a clone of a real, live, commercial website. Do not make it or the clone public without legal clearance. Do not use it to reintroduce the original's content, logos, fonts, vendor marks or artwork.

delivery: Ship source plus package-lock.json and run `npm ci` on the receiving side; do not ship node_modules. The zip is a build artifact: gitignore it if the project is ever put under git.
